ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read “Schematic map of the distribution areas and occurrence counts of sandstorms in our country.” <image1> From the perspective of surface material conditions, what is the direct reason that the Northwest region has become the sand source area of sandstorms in the northern region?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic map of the distribution areas and occurrence counts of sandstorms in our country. The shaded areas with relatively many sandstorm occurrences are mainly concentrated in the Northwest region of our country and the Inner Mongolia area, and extend toward northern North China, indicating that the Northwest region is an important sand source area for sandstorms in the north. Then reason: the question stem restricts the analysis to “surface material conditions,” not to vegetation coverage or climatic conditions. The Northwest region has many deserts, Gobi areas, and exposed sandy soil; surface sandy soil and other materials are loose, and are easily blown up by strong winds to form sand and dust. Therefore the direct reason is that the surface materials are loose.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：中国地图上沙尘暴出现次数的高值区集中在西北—华北北部一带，尤其西北内陆和内蒙古附近阴影较深，说明这些地区是沙尘暴频发、沙源集中的区域。再读题干，限定角度是“从地表物质条件看”，不是问气候或植被。结合地理知识，西北干旱、半干旱区多沙漠、戈壁和裸露沉积物，地表沙土等物质易被风吹起。由此归纳直接原因是：地表物质松散。
